name: v4.24.4
body:
For an installation guide, refer to the [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md).

## 📦 Update MCP Bundle Installation
**For Claude Desktop users:**

→ [Download linkedin-mcp-server-v4.24.4.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.24.4/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.24.4.mcpb)

Then click the downloaded file to install in Claude Desktop.

> **Note:** MCP Bundles do not auto-update. You need to download and install the latest `.mcpb` file for each new release.

## 🐳 Update Docker Installation
**For users with Docker-based MCP client configurations:**
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest
```
The `latest` tag will always point to the most recent release.
To pull this specific version, run:
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:4.24.4
```


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v4.24.4 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* feat(scraping): capture post permalinks on content-search pages by @mattelacchiato in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/999
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(diagnostics): Keep scrape notes off GitHub by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/994
* fix(ci): Keep main runs and 3.13 Windows coverage by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1004
* fix(daemon): Report an unknown outcome after owner loss by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1008
* fix(daemon): Keep a closing session from burying the answer by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1012
* fix(session): Name the Windows arch without WMI by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1013
* fix(daemon): Stop post-call schema discovery by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1017
* fix(scraping): Accept periods in company slugs by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/973
